issues.description: The getter name for StockIngredient.name is inconsistent between the template and the solution. The template defines and uses getIngredientName() (StockIngredient.java and Stock.findStockIngredient()), while the solution defines and uses getName() for the same field. The problem statement asks students to "add getters for all the private fields" but does not specify names, so this mismatch between template and solution is an unintentional structural inconsistency that can confuse students comparing implementations or integrating code from different sources.
issues.suggestedFix: Standardize the getter name for the StockIngredient.name field across template, solution, and documentation. Prefer one naming convention (for example, getName()) and update both StockIngredient.java and any calls (e.g., Stock.findStockIngredient()) in the template and solution to use the chosen getter. Also update the problem statement to explicitly mention the expected getter names if a specific name is required.

issues.description: The StockIngredient name getter is referred to with two different identifiers across artifacts: the template repository exposes getIngredientName(), while the solution repository exposes getName(). This affects related usages such as Stock.findStockIngredient which call the different getter names in template vs solution. Because the problem statement instructs students to "add getters for all the private fields", the differing getter names for the same conceptual field (the ingredient's name) create unnecessary mapping confusion and extra cognitive load when students compare the template, the assignment text, and the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single, consistent getter name for the StockIngredient name field across template and solution. For example, rename getIngredientName() in the template to getName(), and update all call sites (e.g., Stock.findStockIngredient) accordingly — or vice versa in the solution — so the same identifier refers to the same conceptual field in all artifacts.
